story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: Greetings. We are filming on location on board the Royal Caribbean cruise line. My name is Michael Woods, we’re filming for Hamilton College and we’re developing a jazz archive. My guest today is Norman Simmons, a very fine and well traveled keyboard artist. Pleased to have you here.
I’m very pleased to be here.
